newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian protesters storm parliament building.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian protesters storm parliament building.

text.p: Dozens of anti-government protesters broke into the building housing Bulgaria's parliament on Friday during a protest to demand early parliamentary elections, witnesses said.

Police tried to block the protesters' way with tables inside the building, witnesses added. Riot police also used teargas to try to disperse hundreds of oppositon supporters who had surrounded the parliament in a human chain.
"Dozens of demonstrators entered the building and police are trying to block their way with tables," said a Reuter reporter on the scene.

Their protest came after the ruling Bulgarian Socialist Party (BSP) refused to vote on a "salvation declaration" proposed by the opposition Union of Democratic Forces (UDF). It called for an early national poll.
But parliament subsequently began an extrordinary session to discuss the opposition's declaration and voting started on the proposal, speaker Blavest Sendov said.
The opposition says the BSP has failed to tackle the country's economic crisis and now lacks support to form a government.
